meta.title: Historical model M1 schema proposal
meta.status: PROPOSAL (M0). Nothing here is applied to docs/phase34-model.json or data/model/.

StatementMode.note: EXPLICIT: the source states the temporal fact in words. IMPLIED: it follows from the document's framing only (its date, a sheet's vintage, a title year).

CandidateDisposition.note: A property of a candidate within one Reconciliation, not of the Observation: the same claim can be SELECTED in one reconciliation and CONTRADICTS in another.

EvaluationStatus.note: The evaluator's answer for one property at one time (section 6). Never persisted.

Holds.note: Whether one record's validity covers a time point on the record's axis. Never persisted.

TransitionKind.note: Named as in the design (section 6, decision O3). The brief's RELATED_NOT_ESTABLISHED names the same meaning; the design does not confirm that name, so it is not added. One value either way; the name is O3's to settle before M1 writes it.

rules: both bounds are present; each follows the TemporalBound rules
OPEN is not allowed in a window (an event has happened or not; an open end belongs to a Validity)
earliest is not after latest where both are dated
a point event is earliest == latest

claimed_validity.note: the span the source says a state holds; the claim's own assertion, never the record's reconciled validity

claimed_window.note: the window the source says an event happened in

statement_mode.note: required when claimed_validity or claimed_window is present

occurred.note: replaces the single bound `at` for new rows; `at` stays accepted (decision O4 supports both)

dispositions.note: {observation id: {"disposition": CandidateDisposition, "reason": text}}; keys are a subset of candidates; a candidate without an entry is NOT_ASSESSED. A separate field because candidates is list:ref:Observation in 12,959 existing rows.

IdentityTransition.at.note: 0 IdentityTransition rows exist; a row has either at or occurred, read as occurred = {earliest: at, latest: at}

historical_reconciliation_fields.valid_from: the start bound of a state record or NameRecord
historical_reconciliation_fields.exists: whether the record (state, NameRecord, VintageStatement, IdentityTransition) holds at all

invariants.text: A dated bound (EXACT, APPROXIMATE, NO_LATER_THAN, NO_EARLIER_THAN) has a value, an axis and a basis; UNKNOWN, OPEN and NOT_APPLICABLE have no value.
Precision matches the value: DAY YYYY-MM-DD, MONTH YYYY-MM, YEAR YYYY, DECADE YYYYs on CALENDAR; on VINTAGE the value is a year and precision is VINTAGE.
The two dated bounds of one Validity or TimeWindow share one axis; nothing converts between CALENDAR and VINTAGE.
Where both bounds are dated on one axis, the lower is not after the upper (inclusive comparison at the coarser precision).
OPEN only as Validity.valid_to; never in a TimeWindow; UNKNOWN and OPEN are distinct and never interchanged.
Observation.asserted_at (the document's date) is never copied into a record's validity or a transition's window; a claim bound whose basis is an ArtifactDate must be IMPLIED.
A claim has at most one of claimed_validity (a state) and claimed_window (an event), and statement_mode whenever it has either.
RENAMED relates one subject to itself (from == to): one Wine or Estate, a new name. SUCCEEDED_BY relates two different subjects of one entity type. Neither is inferred from the other.
RELATED_UNSPECIFIED and POSSIBLY_SAME carry certainty UNRESOLVED; they establish no identity and no continuity.
A transition with certainty UNRESOLVED ends no validity, moves no NameRecord and is never evaluated as a change.
A FORMER NameRecord on a Wine requires a RENAMED transition on that Wine (or a NameRecord with a dated valid_to and its own reconciliation); no name becomes former by being replaced as current.
Every dated bound of a historical record has a basis; for records written from M3 on, that basis is a Provenance (EVIDENCE_DECISION or DERIVATION) whose derived_from names a Reconciliation.
A Reconciliation of a historical field lists every claim on that subject and field as a candidate; none is dropped.
dispositions keys are a subset of candidates; exactly the selected candidate is SELECTED; REJECTED has a reason; no candidate or Observation is deleted on rejection.
A Reconciliation with status CONFLICT_OPEN or DEFERRED has no selected candidate and no SELECTED disposition.
Until D5 is adopted, a historical reconciliation's rule is ONLY_CANDIDATE, UNANIMOUS or MANUAL_DECISION; never MOST_RECENT_DOCUMENT or SOURCE_PRIORITY.
Absence is never a claim: no Observation, bound or transition is created from a missing sheet, listing or edition.
invariants.enforced_by: process (extraction) + validator (no claim without artifact or provenance quote)

invariants.text: A claim with claimed_validity or claimed_window cites an artifact, or a provenance with a quote.
Every new field is optional; every existing row of data/model/ validates unchanged against the extended contract.
No existing id, provenance, reconciliation or canonical value is rewritten by M1.
A record with valid_from UNKNOWN and valid_to OPEN (every record today) evaluates as UNDETERMINED for any time before its as_of, never HOLDS: current facts do not become historical.
Existing Reconciliations without dispositions read as: selected = SELECTED, other candidates NOT_ASSESSED; their status and rule are unchanged.
The evaluator is pure and read-only: same model, same inputs, same output; it writes nothing.
UNDETERMINED is returned as such, never coerced to HOLDS or DOES_NOT_HOLD; CONTESTED is never shown as ESTABLISHED.
Snapshots and change lists are derived; no persisted table holds them as facts.
A vintage-scoped statement (VintageStatement, a RankAbsence on the VINTAGE axis) applies to its vintages only.

functions.evaluate(subject, property, t, axis, cla: {status: EvaluationStatus, value, records, supporting_claims, contradicting_claims, reconciliations}
functions.state_at(subject, t, axis): {property: evaluate(...)} for every property of the subject

evaluator_contract.inputs: the model as read by tools/model_reader.py; a subject id; a property (name, rank, classification, appellation, relationship, ownership, location, not_made); a time point as {axis, value}; optionally a claimant for rank
evaluator_contract.purity: pure, deterministic, read-only; no I/O beyond reading the model; no clock

status_rules.ESTABLISHED: a record holds (HOLDS) and each bound that decides it is reconciled (SINGLE, AGREED or RESOLVED) and, for identity, certainty CONFIRMED or PROBABLE with a recorded decision
status_rules.CONTESTED: a deciding reconciliation is CONFLICT_OPEN or DEFERRED, or a transition is UNRESOLVED with competing claims
status_rules.UNDETERMINED: records exist but no deciding bound determines t (UNKNOWN, APPROXIMATE across t, the other axis, or only claims IMPLIED)
status_rules.NOT_ESTABLISHED: no record and no claim for the property

fixtures.note: an existing-style observation, no historical field
an existing-style canonical reconciliation: no dispositions, a legacy rule, a non-historical field
